## About the Firm

V C M V & Associates LLP is a multidisciplinary firm of Chartered Accountants (CAs) based in Chennai, India. The firm was established by partners with experience across Big4 accounting firms, established CA practices, and corporate environments.

The firm's name stands for the initials of its founding partners: V (Vinay), C (Chandra), M (Monish), and V (Venkat) — represented as "V C M V" with deliberate spacing.

**Philosophy**: Professional expertise. Practical thinking. Lasting value.

**Specialisation**: The firm is particularly known for its expertise in Direct Tax, International Tax and Transfer Pricing for cross-border businesses, GST advisory and litigation, and Assurance services for mid-to-large enterprises.

**Location**: Willingdon Crescent, 4th Floor, No. 6/2, Dr. S.S. Badrinath Road, Thousand Lights West, Nungambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu – 600 006, India.

**Contact**:
- Phone: +91 99628 69428
- Email: monish@vcmv.in
- WhatsApp: +91 99628 69428
- Office Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM IST; Saturday by appointment

## Services

### Direct Tax Advisory
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/direct-tax
Corporate tax planning, transaction advisory, withholding compliance (TDS/TCS), return filing and representation. The firm covers every dimension of India's direct tax environment — from routine compliance to complex advisory on business restructuring, M&A and regulatory interpretation.

### International Tax
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/international-tax
Cross-border tax structuring and advisory for businesses entering India or expanding globally. Covers DTAA (Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements) analysis, PE (Permanent Establishment) risk, outbound investment structuring and tax-efficient holding structures.

### Transfer Pricing
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/transfer-pricing
End-to-end transfer pricing compliance for inter-company transactions: benchmarking, documentation (Form 3CEB), Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR), and controversy management including APA (Advance Pricing Agreement) assistance and MAP (Mutual Agreement Procedure).

### GST & Indirect Tax
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/gst-indirect-tax
Advisory, compliance, refunds and litigation across Goods and Services Tax (GST), customs duty and other indirect taxes. Covers registration, return filing, ITC optimisation, e-way bills, show cause notices, appeals and representation before adjudicating authorities.

### Taxation of Expatriates
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/expatriates
Tax and regulatory support for expatriates (foreign nationals in India) and businesses managing international employee assignments: residential status determination, FEMA compliance, tax equalisation, shadow payroll, and exit tax planning.

### Assurance & Audit
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/assurance
Statutory audit, tax audit, inventory audit, internal audit, forensic audit, IFC documentation & testing, Ind AS financial statements preparation and IFRS/financial reporting advisory.

### Inventory Audit
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/inventory-audit
Independent physical stock verification, book vs physical reconciliation, valuation review (FIFO, weighted average, NRV), shrinkage and pilferage analysis, slow-moving/obsolete stock identification, and process & controls review. Serves sectors including Retail, Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, FMCG, Automotive, Textiles, Food & Beverage and Logistics.

### Tax Litigation
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/litigation
Technical representation and dispute resolution across income tax, GST, customs and service tax forums. Covers assessment proceedings, CIT(A) and ITAT appeals, High Court matters, GST appellate authority, and advance ruling applications.

### Business Valuation
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/valuation
Independent, purpose-driven valuation for M&A transactions, FEMA/RBI regulatory requirements (FMV for share transfers), financial reporting (Ind AS 113 fair value, impairment testing), ESOP valuations, and strategic decision support.

### Mergers & Acquisitions
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/mergers-acquisitions
Target identification, deal advisory, financial and tax due diligence, valuation, transaction structuring and support through execution and closing. Works on both buy-side and sell-side mandates.

### India Entry Strategies
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/india-entry
Structural, tax and regulatory guidance for foreign businesses establishing an Indian presence: entity selection (subsidiary vs LO vs branch vs JV), incorporation assistance, FEMA/FDI compliance, initial tax registrations and ongoing compliance setup.

### Business & Investment Advisory
URL: https://vcmv.in/services/advisory
Strategic business and investment guidance for critical decisions: growth strategy, business restructuring, capital allocation, investment analysis and financial modelling.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is V C M V & Associates LLP a Big4 firm?**
No. V C M V is an independent CA firm. However, its partners have prior experience working at Big4 firms and established large CA practices, bringing that level of rigour and expertise to a more personalised, partner-led service model.

**Q: What industries does the firm serve?**
The firm serves a broad range of industries including Manufacturing, IT & Software, E-commerce, Pharmaceuticals, Real Estate, Financial Services, FMCG, Retail, Logistics, and businesses with cross-border operations.

**Q: Does the firm handle international tax for foreign companies coming to India?**
Yes. India Entry Strategies and International Tax are core service lines. The firm advises on entity structure, FEMA/FDI compliance, tax treaty benefits, PE risk and ongoing compliance for foreign companies establishing or operating in India.

**Q: What is the office location?**
Willingdon Crescent, 4th Floor, No. 6/2, Dr. S.S. Badrinath Road, Thousand Lights West, Nungambakkam, Chennai – 600 006. Google Maps: the office is near Nungambakkam, Chennai.

**Q: How can I contact the firm?**
Phone: +91 99628 69428 | Email: monish@vcmv.in | WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919962869428 | Contact form: https://vcmv.in/contact
